verdict.rationale: Docs confirm that domains bought via Cloudflare Registrar automatically use Cloudflare's nameservers, implying DNS hosting is bundled with the domain (docs-24), and community reports confirm fast, reliable DNS propagation (comm-16). However, the evidence pack contains no specifics on supported record types, TTL configurability, or details of the DNS management UI experience, and several community comments highlight lock-in to Cloudflare's nameservers as a friction point rather than a seamless experience. Missing for 10: documentation of supported DNS record types, TTL minimums/flexibility, and hands-on evaluation of the DNS management UI's usability.
